candidates.claim: OT-facing port sw-ot-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/7 is an access port in VLAN 30 (CORP), but OT-facing ports must be access ports in VLAN 10.
candidates.remediation: Set sw-ot-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/7 back to access VLAN 10 and confirm the change with the engineer.

candidates.claim: Trunk sw-core-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/22 allows VLANs [10,30,99], which exceeds its approved VLAN set {10,99} by carrying VLAN 30.
candidates.remediation: Remove VLAN 30 from the allowed VLAN list on sw-core-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/22 so it carries only {10,99}.

candidates.claim: The trunk allowed-VLAN list on sw-core-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/22 was changed from the baseline [10,99] to [10,30,99] and must be reconciled.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile this change against the approved baseline and either revert the trunk list to {10,99} or record an approved change.

candidates.claim: The access VLAN on sw-ot-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/7 was changed from the baseline VLAN 10 to VLAN 30 and must be reconciled.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile this change against the approved baseline and revert the access VLAN to 10 or record an approved change.

candidates.claim: A shutdown was added on sw-ot-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/12 relative to the baseline, which falls within the authorized Unit 2 outage window and must be reconciled.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the shutdown against the Unit 2 outage record and restore the port to the baseline state once the outage ends.
